title: Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.29600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. translated_title: 聚合离散度：图神经网络中过平滑的信息几何诊断方法
translated_abstract: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）通过迭代聚合邻居节点的信息来学习节点表示，但当堆叠层数过多时，所有表示会趋于收敛，这种效应被称为过平滑。我们为这一现象提出了一个几何视角。在每一深度 $k$，传播算子为每个节点 $v$ 分配一个游走分布 $p_v^{(k)}$，即源节点上的一个概率分布。这些游走分布在概率单纯形上形成一个点云，其收缩至单点刻画了传播算子的完全混合，从而刻画了过平滑现象。为了度量这种收缩，我们采用 Fisher-Rao 度量——这是单纯形上在充分统计量变换下（至多相差尺度因子）保持不变的唯一黎曼度量，其在平方根嵌入 $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ 下的缩放弦距离即为 Hellinger 距离。由此得到的诊断指标——聚合离散度 $D_k$——是……
tldr: 该论文提出“聚合离散度”这一信息几何诊断指标，利用 Fisher-Rao 度量（等价于 Hellinger 距离）衡量各深度游走分布在概率单纯形上的收缩程度，从而刻画并诊断图神经网络中的过平滑现象。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "aggregation dispersion," an information-geometric diagnostic that leverages the Fisher-Rao metric (equivalently, Hellinger distance) to measure the contraction of walk distributions on the probability simplex across depths, thereby characterizing oversmoothing in graph neural networks.
